rationale: This is a mechanical merge of two archived signals (RND_MOAT_CASH_VERIFIED's R&D×industry-adjusted-margin leg and RND_EXPENSE_EXPLAINS_WEDGE's bounded wedge-share leg) with no new economic content, so its incremental information over already-tested variants is minimal.

The economics (payables-financed operating cash flow contaminating R&D cash verification) were already tested in RND_CASH_AFTER_PAYABLES, and this merely converts the apalch adjustment from a subtraction into a separate multiplicative rank leg on the same template used by GOODWILL_RECEIVABLE_CASH_SHORTFALL.

Sign conventions are handled correctly (NEG(invch) = inventory build, positive recch = receivable collection) and the opposite-sign pairing of the two working-capital legs is a genuinely different configuration from the archived INTAN_DEMAND_WORKCAP_CASH_RELEASE and the sign-contradicted RND_INVENTORY_OBSOLESCENCE_TRAP, though it does bet against the well-known inventory-growth anomaly and should be interpreted cautiously if it works.

Direct rediscovery of CAPITALIZED_RND_SUBSTITUTION_ACCRUAL — the first leg is character-for-character identical and the second differs only by adding xrd inside the same accrual wedge, a cosmetic variant of an already-successful archived signal.

Essentially identical to the archived GOODWILL_RECEIVABLE_CASH_SHORTFALL (same gdwl/at and NEG(recch) legs; the wedge leg differs only by omitting the xrd add-back), making it a rediscovery rather than a new hypothesis.

The under-amortization-plus-accrual-mask economics were already captured by RECOGNIZED_INTAN_UNDERCHARGE_ACCRUAL (which differenced the same dpc and accrual terms), and recasting the difference as a three-way rank product is a cosmetic restructuring that additionally risks the dpc leg simply proxying for asset-light industry membership.
